note: Inputs of the carbon article's CHO-GAP plate, Fig. 14 (src/content/work/figures/cho-gap/combustion-series.svg and combustion-series-narrow.svg), one entry per file. md5 and size_bytes are of the committed file. Unpublished own work; the run is described by the docstring of scripts/figures/combustion_frames.py, the only record the site has of it.
run: 8 CH4 + 16 O2 (72 atoms: 8 C, 32 H, 32 O) in a 10 A periodic cube at 3000 K for 50 ps, driven by the CHO-GAP potential through LAMMPS' pair_style quip. LAMMPS types 1, 2 and 3 are C, H and O (pair_coeff * * <model>.xml "" 6 1 8 in in.cho_opt; the Masses block of combustion_chamber.data agrees). Timestep 0.0005 ps (metal units), a frame dumped every 20 steps, as scaled coordinates wrapped into the cell.
archive_note: The trajectory the frames were cut from is not staged, and neither the script nor the carbon dossier (section 2.6: 'archive input not read') names where it is kept.
processing: Each frame's atoms in id order; each molecule, a connected component of boxprep.find_bonds measured to the nearest periodic image, rebuilt whole and its centroid wrapped back into the cell; the comment line counts the molecules by formula. Committed 2026-08-07 (20534f2). A 40 ps frame extracted with them was used by no figure and was removed on 2026-10-15.
figure_command: render_cluster.py's module docstring: the four frames with --labels "0 ps,10 ps,20 ps,50 ps" --columns 2 --radius-scale 2.2, and again with --narrow.

combustion-0ps.xyz.what: The frame at 0 ps of the run, 72 atoms, every molecule whole.

combustion-10ps.xyz.what: The frame at 10 ps of the run, 72 atoms, every molecule whole.

combustion-20ps.xyz.what: The frame at 20 ps of the run, 72 atoms, every molecule whole.

combustion-50ps.xyz.what: The frame at 50 ps of the run, 72 atoms, every molecule whole.
